const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera and proprioception based controller for one button press episode.
+
+Run stages in order.  Each stage connects to the same live service episode.
+Only the observed target point, calibrated RGB/depth cameras, and proprioception
+are used.  No simulator internals or task success signal are queried.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAMERAS = ("front", "left", "right", "topview")
+
+
+def unpack(obs):
+    layout = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    return dict(zip(layout, obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+
+
+def capture(robot, label):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+    (OUT / f"{label}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{label}_{cam}.png")
+    for cam, depth in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(OUT / f"{label}_depth_{cam}.npy", depth)
+    p = unpack(obs)
+    print(label, "tcp", [round(p[f"tcp_{k}"], 4) for k in "xyz"],
+          "mocap", [round(p[f"mocap_{k}"], 4) for k in "xyz"],
+          "opening", round(p["gripper_opening"], 3),
+          "target", obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"],
+          "steps", obs.meta["control_steps"], flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+
+def execute(robot, actions, label):
+    actions = np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float64)
+    if not len(actions):
+        return
+    res = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=robot.spec()["control_dt"],
+                       interpolate="hold", cameras=("front", "topview"),
+                       video="mp4", note=label)
+    (OUT / f"{label}_actions.npy").write_bytes(actions.tobytes())
+    (OUT / f"{label}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, frame in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{label}_{cam}.png")
+    print(label, "executed", len(actions), "steps; total", res.meta["control_steps"], flush=True)
+    if res.meta.get("done"):
+        raise RuntimeError("Episode ended: " + str(res.meta.get("reason")))
+
+
+def move_to(robot, goal, label, speed=1.0, grip=1.0):
+    obs = capture(robot, label + "_before")
+    p = unpack(obs)
+    start = np.array([p[f"mocap_{k}"] for k in "xyz"])
+    goal = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float)
+    diff = goal - start
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(diff)) / (0.01 * speed))))
+    step = np.clip(diff / (0.01 * n), -1, 1)
+    execute(robot, np.tile(np.r_[step, grip], (n, 1)), label)
+    return capture(robot, label + "_after")
+
+
+def hold(robot, count, label, grip=1.0):
+    execute(robot, np.tile(np.array([0., 0., 0., grip]), (count, 1)), label)
+    return capture(robot, label + "_after")
+
+
+def stage_approach(robot):
+    obs = capture(robot, "start")
+    p = unpack(obs)
+    target = obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"]
+    move_to(robot, (p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], .42), "raise", speed=.8)
+    move_to(robot, (target[0], target[1], .42), "align", speed=.8)
+    hold(robot, 24, "settle_above")
+
+
+def stage_near(robot):
+    obs = capture(robot, "near_start")
+    p = unpack(obs)
+    move_to(robot, (p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], .365), "lower_near", speed=.45)
+    hold(robot, 15, "settle_near")
+
+
+def stage_press(robot):
+    obs = capture(robot, "press_start")
+    p = unpack(obs)
+    move_to(robot, (p["mocap_x"], p["mocap_y"], .215), "press", speed=.35)
+    hold(robot, 60, "hold_press")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    robot = Robot()
+    stage = sys.argv[1]
+    {"approach": stage_approach, "near": stage_near, "press": stage_press}[stage](robot)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
